independent_label_decision.modify_conflict: The source default modify/high conflicts with v0 classes. For the accepted destructive rows, ask is independently grounded in responsibility for stopped-container writable layers, unused volumes, images/build state or complete Podman storage; unused does not establish disposable, and no owner authorization or isolation is visible. The user task explicitly permits ask when a responsible person must decide. Removing --volumes/-v cannot establish safety of remaining teardown, and an internal confirmation prompt does not prove external approval. This is not a mechanical modify-to-ask translation.
independent_label_decision.severity: High is defensible for significant multi-object state loss requiring recovery/intervention; no production or backup is invented. 014 critical is independently justified by deletion of all Podman resources/machines plus graphRoot/runRoot and the explicit important-directory warning. Listing and non-mutating dry-run counterparts are low independently of the paired operation's severity.
independent_label_decision.allow: 006/007/008/015/022 are actual metadata listings without shell evaluation, container execution, redirection or external transmission. 008 prints Command as text rather than executing it. 021 explicitly documents no removal and has matching snapshot CLI support. These are safe inspection tasks, not assertions that they reclaim space or authorize later deletion.
